verify.py.contents:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pin a published Burn commit, verify the resolved Git graph, then run the consumer."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BURN_URL = "https://github.com/onenewcode/burn"
CUBECL_REV = "e97ef2c4dc06e18281effe0b71e1d361b2d1e4c4"
CUBECL_SOURCE = f"git+https://github.com/onenewcode/cubecl?rev={CUBECL_REV}#{CUBECL_REV}"
CUBEK_REV = "2fd57bac2d09c84ab3da08d5bacb6b737646182b"
CUBEK_SOURCE = f"git+https://github.com/onenewcode/cubek?rev={CUBEK_REV}#{CUBEK_REV}"
revision = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) == 2 else ""
assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", revision), "usage: python3 verify.py <published Burn commit SHA>"
manifest = ROOT / "Cargo.toml"
text = manifest.read_text()
settings = tomllib.loads(text)
assert "patch" not in settings and "replace" not in settings
assert settings["workspace"] == {"members": []}
for dep in settings["dependencies"].values():
    assert dep["git"] == BURN_URL and "path" not in dep
    assert dep["rev"] in ("__BURN_REV__", revision)
manifest.write_text(text.replace("__BURN_REV__", revision))
env = dict(os.environ, BURN_DEVICE="cpu", RUSTC_WRAPPER="", RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER="")
metadata = subprocess.check_output(["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version", "1"], cwd=ROOT, env=env)
(ROOT / "metadata.json").write_bytes(metadata)
graph = json.loads(metadata)
packages = graph["packages"]
root_id = graph["resolve"]["root"]
assert graph["workspace_members"] == [root_id]
assert all(p["source"] is not None for p in packages if p["id"] != root_id), "local path dependency or patch found"
burn_source = f"git+{BURN_URL}?rev={revision}#{revision}"
assert all(p["source"] == burn_source for p in packages if p["name"].startswith("burn"))
cubecl = [p for p in packages if p["name"].startswith("cubecl") and p["name"] != "cubecl-hip-sys"]
assert cubecl and {p["source"] for p in cubecl} == {CUBECL_SOURCE}
assert len(cubecl) == len({p["name"] for p in cubecl}), "duplicate CubeCL package versions"
cubek = [p for p in packages if p["name"].startswith("cubek")]
assert cubek and {p["source"] for p in cubek} == {CUBEK_SOURCE}
assert len(cubek) == len({p["name"] for p in cubek}), "duplicate CubeK package versions"
cube_id = next(p["id"] for p in packages if p["name"] == "burn-cubecl")
cube_features = next(n["features"] for n in graph["resolve"]["nodes"] if n["id"] == cube_id)
assert "fusion" not in cube_features and "cpu" in cube_features
result = {"burn_source": burn_source, "cubecl_source": CUBECL_SOURCE, "cubecl_packages": len(cubecl),
          "cubek_source": CUBEK_SOURCE, "cubek_packages": len(cubek)}
with (ROOT / "execution.log").open("w") as log:
    completed = subprocess.run(["cargo", "run", "--locked"], cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
result["exit_code"] = completed.returncode
(ROOT / "validation.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
assert completed.returncode == 0, f"consumer failed: inspect {ROOT / 'execution.log'}"
